testcase.system-out: Scenario: Add a selected command using the keyboard transfer button ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And ribbon customization is open with "All Commands" selected ✔ And the Part | Tools custom target is empty ✔ When the user selects "2D Sketches" in the available commands list ✔ And the user presses Enter while the list has focus ✔ Then "2D Sketches" remains selected in the available commands list ✔ And the Part | Tools target remains empty ✔ And Apply remains disabled ✔ When the user presses Tab and then Space ✔ Then "2D Sketches" appears in the Part | Tools target ✔ And the target is marked as changed ✔ And Apply and cancels are enabled ✔ When the user cancels customization ✔ Then the customization dialog closes
